message.content:
This is a screenshot of the **Chalo** (or similar) public transit app home screen on an Android phone, taken at **3:48**.

## Top area — Map
- A **Google Maps** view (the grey "Google" watermark logo is visible bottom-left of the map) rendered in a **pale pastel style** — light teal/cyan background with white roads and mint-green park areas. Street labels include "Thirumalai Street," "Bharathi Salai," and "SRM Easwari Engineering College" (with some Tamil text visible).
- A **blue circular pedestrian/walking icon marker** with a teardrop pointer sits at the top center, indicating the user's location mode.
- Status bar shows: "Of ...stel" (partial carrier name, likely "Jio...Fidel" style), notification icons (an orange square, purple "Z", blue and yellow app icons), a camera cutout, 0.60 KB/s, 4G, Wi-Fi, and **57% battery**.

## Location banner
Below the map, on a light teal illustrated background with cartoon bushes:
- "**You are in ↗ Ramapuram.**" (underlined link)
- "**No buses available around you.**"

## Search bar
A prominent rounded pill button with a **pink-to-red/orange gradient**: "**Search "Bus Stops"**" with a magnifying-glass icon on the right.

## Mode selector
A horizontally scrolling row of white rounded cards, each with a 3D vehicle illustration and label:
- **Bus** (white bus), **Metro** (white train), **Train** (tram), **Auto** (green/yellow auto-rickshaw), and a partially visible fifth card (brown bus/tram).

## Promo banner (yellow card)
- Huge "**₹1**" numeral.
- "**₹1 Rupee Ticket**" and "**⚡ 1-Click Booking**"
- "**Powered by CUMTA**" (underlined logo-style text)
- A phone mockup illustration on the right showing a "CUMTA UPI Powered by Chalo" card (₹1) with a blue "**GET TICKET**" button.
- Carousel dots below (2nd dot active).

## Track your buses section
- Heading "**Track your buses**"
- "**Nearby Stop:**" with link "**Ramapuram Srm University**"
- A blue pill button "**Show all ›**"
- A white card: "**Towards RAMAPURAM**", route badge "**S26**" (red text on cream), "**To Valasaravakkam**", a live-tracking icon with "**15 MIN**" in green monospace text, and a partially visible second "S26" entry with "EXP SCHEDULED" tags.

## Bottom navigation
Floating white pill bar with 5 items:
- **Home** (red-orange ticket-like logo icon, active)
- **Tickets** (ticket icon)
- **BUS TICKET** — a large raised **blue/purple gradient circular center button** with an icon
- **Pass** (arch/card icon)
- **Account** (person icon)

No sign-in prompt or account details are visible; no database info is shown — this is a standard logged-in (or guest) home screen for browsing nearby transit.
